vacancy.title: AIT Technicians / Sheet Metal Specialists / Senior AIT Shift Leaders / KUKA Robot Operators (15+ positions)
vacancy.location: Leiden / Oegstgeest, Netherlands (Airbus Defence and Space Netherlands; not ESTEC)
vacancy.assessment: Separate Airbus Defence and Space Netherlands hiring-desk requisition SRQ178358 for 15+ production personnel on European launcher structural assemblies: AIT technicians, sheet-metal specialists, senior AIT technicians/shift leaders and KUKA robot operators. On-site Leiden/Oegstgeest with afternoon/evening shifts 14:00–23:00; minimum 9 months, estimated 9–12, detachering or freelance possible. Practical assembly/robotics and leadership relate to industrial automation background, but mostly technician/production roles below MSc mechanical design level, no direct ESTEC placement and no salary published. Distinct from existing Airbus AI-Technician SRQ178313; closing 31 Dec 2026.
